summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing of StormAndMeOfficial. All 20 backend pytest tests passed (books/products/music/videos/posts/faqs, contact + newsletter idempotent, /checkout/session with mixed cart + STORM10 coupon computes totals server-side and persists to orders+payment_transactions, /checkout/status returns order, invalid item -> 400, empty cart -> 400, bad coupon -> zero discount). Frontend flow verified end-to-end: home hero, category filters, book detail Buy Now increments cart, product detail size/color/qty + Add to Cart, cart plus/subtotal, Proceed to Checkout, apply coupon updates total, Pay Securely REDIRECTS to https://checkout.stripe.com (verified live). Contact form submit shows confirmation panel, newsletter shows success toast, FAQ accordion expands, storm-rain-canvas is present + motion toggle removes canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: Coupons/shipping/tax constants are duplicated between backend (server.py) and frontend (Checkout.js). Consider exposing a /api/pricing/config endpoint so any future change stays in one place (currently OK because backend still recomputes authoritative totals).
Frontend Home 'featuredVideo' block conditionally rendered inside a wrapper element — could throw briefly before videos load, but on Home rendering was fine.
Videos endpoint has no /api/videos/{id} route (only list). If a Video detail page is added later, one will be needed.
checkout_status still tries to update order every poll — small extra Mongo writes. Consider skipping when payment_status is already terminal (done for 'paid' but not for 'expired'/'canceled').
test_credentials: N/A — no auth. Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. Coupons: STORM10 (10%), STILLHERE (15%).
seed_data_creation: Data auto-seeded by backend on startup from seed_data.py (8 books, 8 products, 4 music, 6 videos, 4 posts). Newsletter/contact test docs written to Mongo with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file at /app/backend/tests/test_stormandme_api.py works as a regression suite (run with `pytest backend/tests/test_stormandme_api.py -v`). Frontend testids that matter: nav-cart-btn, cart-count, cart-plus-0/minus-0/remove-0/cart-checkout/cart-subtotal, checkout-email/checkout-coupon/checkout-apply-coupon/checkout-pay/checkout-total, book-buy-now, product-add-cart, product-buy-now, size-<S/M/L>, color-<name-slug>, qty-plus/minus/value, storm-rain-canvas, nav-motion-toggle, newsletter-firstname/email/submit, contact-name/email/subject/message/submit/confirmation. Stripe redirect verified live -> checkout.stripe.com. NOTE: on click nav-link-shop from within a page where a Sonner toast is visible, the toast may briefly cover the link; tests should either wait for toast to dismiss or use page.goto for shop.
